title: Align deployment config source of truth
summary: Align setup and launch deployment paths so fresh-package setup, WebView first-run configuration, environment verification, and command-line launchers resolve the same active operator config.
reason: Deployment review found that WebView Guided Setup can save a per-user canonical config while run.bat and setup validation look only at bundle-local config paths, leaving non-developer fresh-package launches ambiguous or broken.
behavior_before: Setup writes bundle-local config by default, WebView first-run setup prefers per-user config, verify-env prefers per-user config, and run.bat ignores per-user config.
behavior_after: Setup, run, verifier, backend recovery, and release self-test now use an explicit per-user-first deployment config contract; run.bat sees WebView-created per-user configs, setup writes per-user config by default when LOCALAPPDATA is available, clean-package verification must opt into missing-config allowance, and setup-generated backups are visible to backend recovery.
